Laboratory Tests for Endocrine Functioning 
Laboratory testing for endocrine disorders includes tests measuring hormones, vitamin levels, electrolytes, and 
kidney function among others. Table 7.2 lists the commonly ordered laboratory tests specific to endocrine 
disorders.
